notes: THE OWNER: "no person is going to edit code in forms/dialog... they will expect a full featured editor will expert knowledge of the programming language being used, with code complete, compiler/interpreter error checking, packaging, test suite execution, etc." THE LOCKFILE TEXT IS NOW A LANGUAGE, NOT A RENDERING. server/program-lang.js is ONE formatter and ONE parser, both server-side: the buffer the IDE edits is format()'s own output (carried on the report as g.source, so the viewer and the parser cannot drift), and save runs parse() → the SAME validatePins a deploy runs → program.deploy — sa
